source_snapshot.procedure: Test connections between BMC I2C-7 and HPM1.
source_snapshot.criteria: BMC can successfully communicate with I2C devices on second HPM.
source_snapshot.script: AI_VR_I2C_bus7; 10 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; proposes BMC i2cdetect/i2cget plus operator inspection, but cannot prove literal bus safety or distinguish HPM1 from a repeated HPM0 address pattern.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/MEDIUM; held Pending for 2P/HPM1 population, controller/mux path, HPM1-specific identities, safe transactions, photos and recovery.

old_problem: A raw scan on an assumed I2C-7 adapter can validate or disturb the wrong mux channel, and repeated address layouts let HPM0 responses masquerade as second-HPM coverage. Physical HPM1 population and identity-bearing communication were both unspecified.
disposition_reason: The exact 2P objective supports a safe parameterized case: first prove HPM1 is physically populated, then select the signed BMC controller/mux path and reconcile an HPM1-specific identity allowlist. Project topology and OEM transactions remain closed runtime inputs; they need not keep the review Pending when no value is guessed and wrong-channel substitution is explicitly rejected.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2158, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2159 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00046-V002 / a5c8db716346852d was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind proof of the approved 2P state and distinguish HPM1/second-HPM from HPM0 in both physical and logical topology.
Map logical BMC I2C-7 through controller, adapter and mux/channel to the HPM1 connector; do not infer a Linux adapter number.
Bind an HPM1-specific device/address/identity register oracle and an owner-approved read-only method/prohibited transaction list.
Operator verifies and photographs HPM1 population/connector; the automated portion proves each response is on the second-HPM path, not a shared HPM0 address pattern.
Stop on wrong-channel response, missing/unexpected identity or bus/BMC fault; no unknown scan, write, reset or automatic retry.
No BMC/I2C query, physical manipulation, write, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: HPM1 second-HPM 2P physical and BMC I2C-7 identity validation
test_case.purpose: Prove the approved 2P platform has HPM1 physically connected and independently reachable through the intended BMC I2C-7 mux path, with every required second-HPM device returning its HPM1-specific identity.
required_package: Approved 2P population record and HPM1-versus-HPM0 physical/topology map
HPM1-specific address and stable identity register/value allowlist plus prohibited transactions
Vendor-approved non-destructive BMC/OOB inventory or read-only method
Operator inspection/photos, bus-error acceptance and vendor recovery procedure
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Operator verifies and photographs the second processor/HPM position and HPM1 connector. Select only the approved BMC I2C-7 HPM1 mux path, run the approved inventory or allowlisted read-only identity queries, and reconcile every HPM1 response to the second-HPM oracle with pre/post bus-health evidence; never substitute HPM0 results.
test_case.expected_result: The required 2P/HPM1 population and physical path are proven; every expected second-HPM device returns the approved HPM1 identity on the mapped channel, with no HPM0/wrong-channel substitution, missing/unexpected device, timeout, stuck bus or BMC fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires signed 2P physical evidence plus complete HPM1-specific identity reconciliation and clean bus health. FAIL on wrong population/path, HPM0 substitution, missing/mismatched/unexpected device or bus/BMC fault. Missing topology/oracle/safe method is runtime BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until 2P/HPM1 topology, identity oracle, safe transactions, inspection state and recovery are signed.
Physical work is operator-only under the service procedure.
No generic scan, unknown register access, quick-write, EEPROM/control write, blind reset or automatic retry.
Stop on wrong-channel evidence, topology ambiguity, timeout, stuck bus, arbitration/error storm or BMC instability.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and approved 2P/HPM1 population record
BMC I2C-7 controller/adapter/mux/channel map and HPM1-specific allowlist
Exact approved method plus complete second-HPM identity comparison
Pre/post BMC/I2C errors and management health
Wrong-channel checks, discrepancy/recovery record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop and preserve evidence on a wrong-channel or bus fault. Use only the vendor-approved recovery for the mapped HPM1 path; do not rescan, write or blindly reset. Quarantine and escalate if BMC or HPM state cannot be restored to baseline.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure, Criteria and bundle consistently target BMC I2C-7 to the second HPM in a 2P configuration.

blocked.reason: The 2P/HPM1 objective, evidence layers and safe target-bound method are complete; runtime remains gated on exact project topology, oracle and operator evidence.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: 2P/HPM1 population, I2C-7 controller/mux/channel map, HPM1-specific device identities, approved read-only method, physical procedure, error criteria and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; PARAMETERIZED HPM1 BMC I2C GATE CLOSED; NO QUERY, PHYSICAL MANIPULATION, WRITE, RESET, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: Platform/BMC topology owner, hardware service owner and recovery authority
pending.unlock_condition: Bind the signed HPM1 topology/oracle/safe method and authorize operator inspection plus read-only validation; no new review decision is required absent topology change.

external_authorities.authority: Exact Master row, Wistron BMC-scope I2C rule and approved ED-01/ED-02/ED-03/ED-07/ED-08/ED-09/ED-11/ED-12/ED-17/ED-20/ED-30
external_authorities.application: Requires target-bound BMC evidence, manual physical proof, safe approved commands, recovery and no guessed OEM parameters or retries.

project_authority: Platform/BMC owner supplies 2P/HPM1 topology and safe reads; hardware owner supplies physical procedure; recovery owner approves response; engineer owns verdict.
